priorityList.notes: Evocation when you are nearly dry and more than 30 seconds of the fight remain. It is an 8 second channel at +1500% mana regeneration on an 8 minute cooldown, so it comes once a boss: spend your gem, a Major Mana Potion and a Demonic Rune first. Inside the last 30 seconds the mana comes back too late to spend, so keep casting.

Arcane Power on cooldown, together with Presence of Mind, your on-use trinkets and your racial. It is 30% more damage for 15 seconds at 30% more mana a cast, off the global cooldown, so press it between casts. On a fresh pull, give the tank a Sunder or two first.
Presence of Mind on cooldown, with Arcane Power. Your next spell is instant, so spend it on a 2.5 second Frostbolt, never on an Arcane Blast that the global cooldown already caps at 1.5 seconds.

Frostbolt the moment Presence of Mind is up, so the 2.5 second cast goes out instant. Presence of Mind on a 1.5 second Arcane Blast saves nothing, since the global cooldown already holds you that long.

Arcane Missiles the moment Missile Barrage lights up. The proc makes it free, halves the channel and fires a missile every half second. Arcane Blast procs it 40% of the time and Frostbolt 20%, so this is a big share of your damage. Rank 7 is the top trainer rank; rank 8 is a book from Ahn'Qiraj.

Arcane Blast to 3 stacks, then a 4th while you are above 20% mana and ahead of the fight. Ahead of the fight means more of your mana bar left than of the fight: half the fight left with more than half your mana, keep blasting. Each stack adds 12% of your Intellect as spell damage and raises the next Blast's cost by 100%. The buff lasts 18 seconds from the first Blast and does not refresh. A Clearcasting proc makes even a stacked Blast free.

Frostbolt fills the rest of the 18 seconds once you stop blasting. The stacks' spell damage still applies to it, it procs Missile Barrage 20% of the time, and it costs a fraction of a stacked Blast. When the stacks fall off, the next Blast starts a cheap new set.
Shoot only when you are out of mana and waiting on a gem, a rune or Evocation. A wand shot holds you for the wand's full speed, so never weave it between spells.
